selection: fixed approved admin and customer identities plus exact vehicle IDs and exact source/target database fingerprints

lock.transactionBoundary: serializable target transaction; recompute the approved manifest after the advisory lock before any insert

cancellation: cancel before commit; a lost process after commit is outcome-unknown and only registered reconcile may determine the result
idempotency: apply inserts one exact baseline and one audit fact; replay validates the exact committed manifest with zero additional writes
checksums: plan binds source/target identities, input, exact manifest, per-domain row digests and expected per-table write totals
exitCondition: retire after the Stage1 clean acceptance baseline is no longer required
